releaseName: Coming Up tells the whole truth
notes: Fixed: a part payment no longer counts as the whole thing. If you log $50 against a $200 minimum, Coming Up keeps showing the account and says how much of it you’ve logged so far.

Fixed: a future-dated payment is money that hasn’t moved yet. If it’s dated after the due day, the account still shows as coming up — and when it is scheduled in time, the card says “scheduled” rather than “logged”.
Fixed: marking your only bill as paid used to make the row disappear with no way to undo it. It now stays on the card until its due day passes.
